title: CO-HABIT Workshop at IEEE RO-MAN: Final Call for Papers
excerpt: A call shared by co-organiser Doreen Jirak invited work on explainable AI, trust and human-centred interaction for the CO-HABIT Workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2025. Archived call for papers.

zh.title: IEEE RO-MAN上的CO-HABIT研讨会：论文征集最后通知
zh.excerpt: 联合组织者 Doreen Jirak 分享的征稿启事，邀请研究者为 IEEE RO-MAN 2025 的 CO-HABIT Workshop 投稿，主题包括可解释人工智能、信任和以人为中心的交互。此征稿启事已存档。
